- A quick run-through of the joint GTM play (who owns which assets, demo cadence).
- An exec handoff at the end of the week (VP-level, ~20 minutes).

Suggested windows: Thu 9/30 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 9/30 14:00–15:00 PT. If neither works, happy to be flexible.

I've attached a draft timetable our POC compiled (see "catalyst-ma-timetable.xlsx"). Can you loop in the right folks on your side?

Agenda (30m orientation)

- 10m marketplace listing & procurement checklist (Kimberly)

Exec handoff (20m)

- Kimberly — can you confirm the listing/legal prerequisites and whether we should surface the SOW draft in advance?
- Karthik — can you prepare a 5-minute demo dry-run focused on the integration points Catalyst highlighted?
- Ava/Jordan — please share any procurement contacts at Catalyst we should loop into the procurement thread.
